_comment: Clear acrylic (PMMA, sold as Plexiglas or Perspex): the water-clear cast or extruded sheet of display cases, sneeze guards, signs and picture glazing. TranslucentThin: a sheet is a thin shell seen through, the same master as the glass panes (Glass_Clear, Glass_Frosted). Polished and colourless, with a lower index than glass (1.49), so its reflections are a little weaker. Carries every relevant wear layer at 0 (C1): hairline scratches (overlay 1, damage: acrylic is soft and scratches finely with cleaning), fingerprints, and dust as a deposit (Phase10), gated by the Grime mask in the row's order. Built by the Phase11 batch.
